description: Grants the hosted Portal origin exactly ONE capability: raising OS notifications. This is the only IPC the remote origin has, and it is deliberately isolated in its own file so the grant is obvious in review -- `default.json` remains remote-free. Consequence to understand before widening this: any script running on portal.caelonhq.com, including one injected via XSS or a compromised dependency, can raise notifications with arbitrary text. It cannot reach filesystem, shell, window, or process APIs. Do not add permissions here; add a separate capability with its own justification instead. NOTE: the URL below is static and must be updated by hand if CAELON_PORTAL_URL is repointed at another deployment.
